description: Clone a Sequence - Create a copy of an existing sequence. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience. Blocklist and unsubscribe suppression is always enforced. The copy is always PAUSED, has no lists and sends nothing until update_sequence_status sets it ACTIVE with the user's confirmation.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.
